findings.what: insertContactMessage not wrapped in try/catch; a DB failure throws from the server action, showing the error boundary and losing the visitor's form input instead of a form-level error
Relies on experimental node:sqlite and a local file DB under process.cwd()/data; not persistent/writable on many hosting targets, which risks losing messages meant for admin reading
Client maxLength counts UTF-16 units while server counts code points, so client blocks non-BMP input before the server limit; no client maxLength on email
